findings.rationale: The light amber/gold font color used for displaying product prices ($450.00, $120.00, $890.00, $1,200.00) against the white background provides poor visual contrast, degrading legibility and making essential pricing details difficult to read.
findings.improvement_suggestion: Increase the contrast of the price text by using a darker shade of amber or a neutral dark color like charcoal or black.

findings.rationale: A hamburger menu icon is placed directly next to visible top-level text links ('New Arrivals', 'Best Sellers', 'Categories') on a full desktop layout. Combining a hamburger icon with partial visible navigation breaks established navigation design standards and creates ambiguity regarding where the complete site navigation is located.
findings.improvement_suggestion: Display all primary navigation items directly in the desktop header, or provide an explicit text label (such as 'Menu') if the hamburger icon is intended to open an auxiliary drawer.

findings.violated_heuristic: H2 — Match Between the System and the Real World
findings.rationale: The footer uses generic icons (a globe and an operating system share icon) alongside a camera icon instead of standard, recognizable brand logos for social media platforms, making it unclear where these links lead.
findings.improvement_suggestion: Replace the generic globe and share glyphs with recognizable brand logos for the corresponding social media channels (e.g., Instagram, Pinterest, Facebook, or X).
